Migration script (PostgreSQL):

```sql
-- Add new columns (idempotent check)
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_name = 'users' AND column_name = 'first_name') THEN
    ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN first_name VARCHAR(255);
  END IF;
END $$;

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_name = 'users' AND column_name = 'last_name') THEN
    ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_name VARCHAR(255);
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Backfill (only unfilled rows)
UPDATE users 
SET 
  first_name = TRIM(SPLIT_PART(full_name, ' ', 1)),
  last_name = CASE 
    WHEN full_name ~ ' ' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(full_name FROM POSITION(' ' IN full_name) + 1))
    ELSE ''
  END
WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL AND first_name IS NULL;

-- Drop old column when safe (run after data verified)
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_name = 'users' AND column_name = 'full_name') THEN
    ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN full_name;
  END IF;
END $$;
```

**Key safety features:**
- Column existence checks prevent duplicate-add errors
- `first_name IS NULL` check skips already-migrated rows (re-runnable)
- Splits "John Smith" → first_name='John', last_name='Smith'
- Handles single names: "Prince" → first_name='Prince', last_name=''
- Final DROP only runs if column exists

Run all steps together first run. On reruns, safe to repeat—new rows backfill, existing rows skip.
